row.evidence: Kiwi TCMS subscriptions (Self Support $35/mo, Private Tenant $150/mo, Enterprise $600/mo) list authentication backends ("OAuth, LDAP authentication backends" on Enterprise) but no SCIM, and the documentation search returns no SCIM or provisioning results.
row.notes: Flat per-instance subscriptions, not per user ('Unlimited users' on Private Tenant), so per-user fields are null. Prices rose since June: Self Support $25 to $35/mo, Private Tenant $75 to $150/mo, Enterprise $400 to $600/mo (monthly list price on kiwitcms.org; paying 1 or 3 years upfront saves 5%, 7% and 10%). The June pricing URL kiwitcms.org/pricing/ now returns 404; subscriptions are on the homepage. No SCIM on any tier: none by absence (pricing, docs search API for scim/saml/provisioning returned 0 results, RPC API reference, admin guide, Enterprise README). Enterprise (self-hosted) adds python-social-auth backends (including a SAML backend per the Enterprise changelog) and LDAP, so sso_plan is Enterprise. Private Tenant has 'No User account admin'. The open-source JSON-RPC/XML-RPC API (all editions) can list, update, deactivate users and add them to groups, but has no create-user method.
